children: ) is scheduled to release its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Broadridge will host a webcast and conference call to discuss those results at 8:30 a.m. ET on November 3, 2026. Tim Gokey, Chief Executive Officer, and Ashima Ghei, Chief Financial Officer, will participate on the call.
